## Professional Summary
Louisse Dominique Bertillo (also known professionally as Louisse Baja or HesuCrypt) is a senior-level web engineer and creative technologist specializing in:
- High-conversion business websites and landing pages (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion)
- Custom e-commerce platforms and storefront optimizations (Shopify Liquid, headless commerce)
- AI agent systems, LLM integrations (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude), and automated workflow pipelines (n8n, webhook architecture)
- Creative technology & interactive web apps (procedural Web Audio API sound engines, draggable OS window managers)

## Proven Track Record & Commercial Metrics
- **ISSY Cosmetics (Lead IT & AI Implementation):** Drove a +170% increase in online e-commerce sales, re-engineered high-traffic storefront performance, and automated operations across customer service and inventory using n8n and Claude AI.
- **Real-Time Browser Game Launch:** Architected and deployed an interactive browser-based game that scaled to 3,400 concurrent players in 72 hours under heavy traffic.
- **Meridian Auctions (Germany):** Refactored and hardened an inherited full-stack auction platform codebase, eliminating critical vulnerabilities and ensuring zero-downtime reliability.
- **La Fleur:** Designed and delivered an end-to-end bespoke brand and e-commerce experience on a tight timeline ahead of seasonal peak traffic.
